# Augusta

## Doctors of Physical Therapy

### Welcome to Augusta!

At our Augusta location, we go out of our way to make your physical rehabilitation and recovery a great experience. If you do not have a prescription – no problem! Direct Access means you get to choose where you go for treatment. We’ll work closely with you and your physician to develop an individualized treatment plan that works for you in your life. We can even refer you to a great physician, if needed.

We will do everything in our power to accommodate your busy schedule. All of our locations have flexible hours to help you get the physical therapy you need, when you need it. We’re here to help you get better, faster!

Our friendly staff is happy to walk you through necessary paperwork and assist in any way possible, including insurance questions and scheduling. We’ll even call your insurance company for you to help you understand your benefits.

We can’t wait to see you!

### Find us Here

708 W Washington St.

Augusta, WI 54772

### Get In touch

Phone: 715-286-2488

Fax: 715-286-2493

### Clinic Hours

Mon: 7am- 7pm

Tues: 7am- 7pm

Wed: 7am- 7pm

Thurs: 7am- 7pm

Fri: 7am- 7pm

Saturday: Closed

Sunday: Closed
